source_text:
Κλήμης ὁ γενόμενος ἐπίσκοπος Ῥωμαίων ἔγραψε Ἐπιστολήν· ὑπό τινων δὲ, ὅτι
Λουκᾶς ὁ γράψας τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, καὶ τὰς Πράξεις.
pass_a_gloss: Clement who became bishop of the Romans wrote the letter; but according to others, that Luke who wrote the Gospel and the Acts wrote it.
pass_b_english: Clement, who became bishop of Rome, wrote the letter; others say it was Luke, the writer of the Gospel and of Acts.

choices.choice: Clement who became bishop of Rome as one reported penman.
Luke of Gospel and Acts as the other reported penman.
cover both named options; no invented third author.

notes: True OET complete literary English covering locked Greek
Khazarzar Origenes; Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD
